<script nonce="">
    // Defence-in-depth: strip any query param whose name contains "password" from location.href
    // before any tracker (GA4, GTM, Zendesk, Sentry, …) reads it. A stray GET form submission
    // with name="password", "new-password", "wifiPassword", etc. would otherwise put the
    // password in the URL and into every page_location event. Substring match (case-insensitive)
    // covers every password-bearing field name in our forms, current and future. `token`,
    // `code`, etc. are intentionally left intact — the password reset and OAuth callback
    // flows in the Vue app legitimately consume them.
    (function () {
        try {
            var url = new URL(window.location.href);
            var changed = false;
            Array.from(url.searchParams.keys()).forEach(function (key) {
                if (key.toLowerCase().indexOf('password') !== -1) {
                    url.searchParams.delete(key);
                    changed = true;
                }
            });
            if (changed) window.history.replaceState(null, '', url.toString());
        } catch (e) { /* never let scrubbing crash the page */ }
    })();

    (function(){

        const a11yPrefs = {
            "reduced_motion": mediaQueryValue('prefers-reduced-motion'),
            "color_scheme": mediaQueryValue('prefers-color-scheme', ['dark', 'light']),
            "forced_colors": mediaQueryValue('forced-colors'),
            "prefers_contrast": mediaQueryValue('prefers-contrast', ['more', 'less', 'custom']),
        };

        const consent = mv.getConsentData();

        const GTAG_MEASUREMENT_ID = 'G-25N4MEEKJF';
        const gtmLoaded = timeout(new Promise((resolve) => {
            window.dataLayer = [
                {'event': 'page_init', 'csp-nonce': '',
                    'eventCallback': function (tracker) {
                        if (tracker === GTAG_MEASUREMENT_ID) {
                            resolve();
                        }
                    }
                },
                {
                event: 'page_view',
                sanitized: {
                    page_location: sanitizePageUrl("\/llms-full.txt"),
                    page_path: "\/llms-full.txt",
                    page_title: document.title,
                    language: ""
                },
                page: { page_name: "\/llms-full.txt" },
                user: mv.getTrackingUser(),
                a11y: a11yPrefs
                }
                        ];
        }), 20_000, 'Timed out loading GTM');

        /** Check the value for a media query.  If no values are passed, this simply returns a boolean. Otherwise,
         * it returns the matching value, or undefined if none match.
         * If the client does not support media queries, this returns undefined. */
        function mediaQueryValue(q, values) {
            const watcher = window.matchMedia(`(${q})`);
            if (!watcher) return undefined;

            if (!values) return watcher.matches;

            for (const value of values) {
                if (window.matchMedia(`(${q}: ${value})`).matches) return value;
            }
            return undefined;
        }

        function sanitizePageUrl(url) {
            // The query params with personal data. They are a copy of PII_SEARCH_PARAMS and
            // PII_SEARCH_PARAM_PARTS in @mv/tracking-core, and a spec in @mv/web fails when they differ.
            // Matching ignores case, '-' and '_', so entries are stored without separators.
            const sanitizeSearchParamsDenylist = new Set([
                'subscription',
                'subscriptionid',
                'bbsubscriptionid',
                'tpssubscriptionid',
                'customercode',
                'msisdn',
                'number',
                'iccid',
                'order',
                'orderid',
                'topupid',
                'topuporderid',
                'mandate',
                'basketid',
                'circuitid',
                'address',
                'simshippingaddress',
                'firstname',
                'lastname',
                'birthdate',
                'iban',
                't',
                'token',
                'authtoken',
                'accesstoken',
                'idtoken',
                'refreshtoken',
                'code',
                'employerinvitationtoken',
                'clanreference',
                'formhash',
                'connections',
                'redirectto',
                'mobilenumber',
                'customerid',
                'wifiname',
                'ssid',
                'fields',
                'generatedresult',
                'hsenc',
            ]);
            const sanitizeSearchParamsDenylistParts = ['password', 'email', 'phone'];
            const sourceUrl = new URL(url, window.location.origin);

            Array.from(sourceUrl.searchParams.keys()).forEach(function(key) {
                const normalized = key.replace(/^(amp;)+/i, '').toLowerCase().replace(/[_-]/g, '');
                const hasDeniedPart = sanitizeSearchParamsDenylistParts.some(function(part) {
                    return normalized.indexOf(part) !== -1;
                });
                if (hasDeniedPart || sanitizeSearchParamsDenylist.has(normalized)) {
                    sourceUrl.searchParams.delete(key);
                }
            });

            const hashQueryIndex = sourceUrl.hash.indexOf('?');
            sourceUrl.hash = hashQueryIndex > -1 ? sourceUrl.hash.slice(0, hashQueryIndex) : sourceUrl.hash;

            return sourceUrl.toString();
        }

        const trackingIdsPromise = timeout(gtmLoaded
                .then(() => Promise.all([getGtagValue('client_id'), getGtagValue('session_id')]))
                .then(([clientId, sessionId]) => ({ clientId, sessionId })),
            10_000, 'timed out loading tracking IDs');

        trackingIdsPromise
            .then((trackingIds) => ( consent.analytical ?
                window.mobileVikingsStatsig.updateUserAsync({
                    custom: {
                        clientId: trackingIds.clientId,
                        sessionId: trackingIds.sessionId,
                    }
                }) : undefined))
            .catch(function() {
                // We're not logging this as most error cases are caused due to AdBlockers
            });

        window.mv = { ...(window.mv || {}), trackingIdsPromise };

        function getGtagValue(key) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                if (typeof gtag === 'undefined') {
                    reject(new Error('gtag is not available'));
                    return;
                }
                gtag('get', GTAG_MEASUREMENT_ID, key, (value) => {
                    resolve(value);
                });
            });
        }

        function timeout(promise, timeoutMs, description) {
            return Promise.race([
                promise,
                new Promise((resolve, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(description), timeoutMs)),
            ]);
        }
    })();

<script nonce="">
    // Defence-in-depth: strip any query param whose name contains "password" from location.href
    // before any tracker (GA4, GTM, Zendesk, Sentry, …) reads it. A stray GET form submission
    // with name="password", "new-password", "wifiPassword", etc. would otherwise put the
    // password in the URL and into every page_location event. Substring match (case-insensitive)
    // covers every password-bearing field name in our forms, current and future. `token`,
    // `code`, etc. are intentionally left intact — the password reset and OAuth callback
    // flows in the Vue app legitimately consume them.
    (function () {
        try {
            var url = new URL(window.location.href);
            var changed = false;
            Array.from(url.searchParams.keys()).forEach(function (key) {
                if (key.toLowerCase().indexOf('password') !== -1) {
                    url.searchParams.delete(key);
                    changed = true;
                }
            });
            if (changed) window.history.replaceState(null, '', url.toString());
        } catch (e) { /* never let scrubbing crash the page */ }
    })();

    (function(){

        const a11yPrefs = {
            "reduced_motion": mediaQueryValue('prefers-reduced-motion'),
            "color_scheme": mediaQueryValue('prefers-color-scheme', ['dark', 'light']),
            "forced_colors": mediaQueryValue('forced-colors'),
            "prefers_contrast": mediaQueryValue('prefers-contrast', ['more', 'less', 'custom']),
        };

        const consent = mv.getConsentData();

        const GTAG_MEASUREMENT_ID = 'G-25N4MEEKJF';
        const gtmLoaded = timeout(new Promise((resolve) => {
            window.dataLayer = [
                {'event': 'page_init', 'csp-nonce': '',
                    'eventCallback': function (tracker) {
                        if (tracker === GTAG_MEASUREMENT_ID) {
                            resolve();
                        }
                    }
                },
                {
                event: 'page_view',
                sanitized: {
                    page_location: sanitizePageUrl("\/en\/"),
                    page_path: "\/en\/",
                    page_title: document.title,
                    language: "en"
                },
                page: { page_name: "\/en\/" },
                user: mv.getTrackingUser(),
                a11y: a11yPrefs
                }
                        ];
        }), 20_000, 'Timed out loading GTM');

        /** Check the value for a media query.  If no values are passed, this simply returns a boolean. Otherwise,
         * it returns the matching value, or undefined if none match.
         * If the client does not support media queries, this returns undefined. */
        function mediaQueryValue(q, values) {
            const watcher = window.matchMedia(`(${q})`);
            if (!watcher) return undefined;

            if (!values) return watcher.matches;

            for (const value of values) {
                if (window.matchMedia(`(${q}: ${value})`).matches) return value;
            }
            return undefined;
        }

        function sanitizePageUrl(url) {
            // The query params with personal data. They are a copy of PII_SEARCH_PARAMS and
            // PII_SEARCH_PARAM_PARTS in @mv/tracking-core, and a spec in @mv/web fails when they differ.
            // Matching ignores case, '-' and '_', so entries are stored without separators.
            const sanitizeSearchParamsDenylist = new Set([
                'subscription',
                'subscriptionid',
                'bbsubscriptionid',
                'tpssubscriptionid',
                'customercode',
                'msisdn',
                'number',
                'iccid',
                'order',
                'orderid',
                'topupid',
                'topuporderid',
                'mandate',
                'basketid',
                'circuitid',
                'address',
                'simshippingaddress',
                'firstname',
                'lastname',
                'birthdate',
                'iban',
                't',
                'token',
                'authtoken',
                'accesstoken',
                'idtoken',
                'refreshtoken',
                'code',
                'employerinvitationtoken',
                'clanreference',
                'formhash',
                'connections',
                'redirectto',
                'mobilenumber',
                'customerid',
                'wifiname',
                'ssid',
                'fields',
                'generatedresult',
                'hsenc',
            ]);
            const sanitizeSearchParamsDenylistParts = ['password', 'email', 'phone'];
            const sourceUrl = new URL(url, window.location.origin);

            Array.from(sourceUrl.searchParams.keys()).forEach(function(key) {
                const normalized = key.replace(/^(amp;)+/i, '').toLowerCase().replace(/[_-]/g, '');
                const hasDeniedPart = sanitizeSearchParamsDenylistParts.some(function(part) {
                    return normalized.indexOf(part) !== -1;
                });
                if (hasDeniedPart || sanitizeSearchParamsDenylist.has(normalized)) {
                    sourceUrl.searchParams.delete(key);
                }
            });

            const hashQueryIndex = sourceUrl.hash.indexOf('?');
            sourceUrl.hash = hashQueryIndex > -1 ? sourceUrl.hash.slice(0, hashQueryIndex) : sourceUrl.hash;

            return sourceUrl.toString();
        }

        const trackingIdsPromise = timeout(gtmLoaded
                .then(() => Promise.all([getGtagValue('client_id'), getGtagValue('session_id')]))
                .then(([clientId, sessionId]) => ({ clientId, sessionId })),
            10_000, 'timed out loading tracking IDs');

        trackingIdsPromise
            .then((trackingIds) => ( consent.analytical ?
                window.mobileVikingsStatsig.updateUserAsync({
                    custom: {
                        clientId: trackingIds.clientId,
                        sessionId: trackingIds.sessionId,
                    }
                }) : undefined))
            .catch(function() {
                // We're not logging this as most error cases are caused due to AdBlockers
            });

        window.mv = { ...(window.mv || {}), trackingIdsPromise };

        function getGtagValue(key) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                if (typeof gtag === 'undefined') {
                    reject(new Error('gtag is not available'));
                    return;
                }
                gtag('get', GTAG_MEASUREMENT_ID, key, (value) => {
                    resolve(value);
                });
            });
        }

        function timeout(promise, timeoutMs, description) {
            return Promise.race([
                promise,
                new Promise((resolve, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(description), timeoutMs)),
            ]);
        }
    })();

            const sanitizeSearchParamsDenylist = new Set([
                'subscription',
                'subscriptionid',
                'bbsubscriptionid',
                'tpssubscriptionid',
                'customercode',
                'msisdn',
                'number',
                'iccid',
                'order',
                'orderid',
                'topupid',
                'topuporderid',
                'mandate',
                'basketid',
                'circuitid',
                'address',
                'simshippingaddress',
                'firstname',
                'lastname',
                'birthdate',
                'iban',
                't',
                'token',
                'authtoken',
                'accesstoken',
                'idtoken',
                'refreshtoken',
                'code',
                'employerinvitationtoken',
                'clanreference',
                'formhash',
                'connections',
                'redirectto',
                'mobilenumber',
                'customerid',
                'wifiname',
                'ssid',
                'fields',
                'generatedresult',
                'hsenc',
            ]);
            const sanitizeSearchParamsDenylistParts = ['password', 'email', 'phone'];
            const sourceUrl = new URL(url, window.location.origin);

            Array.from(sourceUrl.searchParams.keys()).forEach(function(key) {
                const normalized = key.replace(/^(amp;)+/i, '').toLowerCase().replace(/[_-]/g, '');

                    return normalized.indexOf(part) !== -1;

            sourceUrl.hash = hashQueryIndex > -1 ? sourceUrl.hash.slice(0, hashQueryIndex) : sourceUrl.hash;

            10_000, 'timed out loading tracking IDs');

                    custom: {
                        clientId: trackingIds.clientId,
                        sessionId: trackingIds.sessionId,

                // We're not logging this as most error cases are caused due to AdBlockers
            });

        function getGtagValue(key) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                if (typeof gtag === 'undefined') {
                    reject(new Error('gtag is not available'));
                    return;
                }
                gtag('get', GTAG_MEASUREMENT_ID, key, (value) => {
                    resolve(value);
                });
            });
        }

        function timeout(promise, timeoutMs, description) {
            return Promise.race([
                promise,
                new Promise((resolve, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(description), timeoutMs)),
            ]);
        }
